seo.title: Almyra Paphos Cyprus: Design Adults-Only Honeymoon (2026)
seo.description: Design-led 5-star Paphos with adults-only Kyma suites. Score 90/100, from €360/night. Best suite, 7-night plan, real cost, honest 2026 verdict, email.

content.verdict: Almyra is the design-led sister to the Annabelle — another Thanos Hotels property on the Paphos seafront, but with a deliberately younger, more architectural personality and a strong tilt toward couples (the Kyma adults-only suite zone is the highest couples-percentage of any Cyprus hotel). Originally a 1970s landmark, Almyra was rebuilt in 2003 to a Joëlle Pléot–overseen design with clean lines, raw natural materials (stone, walnut, raw linen), and the kind of Mediterranean-modernist vocabulary that holds up against any Greek-island design property. The Kyma adults-only zone is the honeymoon centre — eight rooftop suites with their own private pool, a separate restaurant (the Notios at the rooftop), and yoga sessions on the rooftop terrace at sunrise. Almyra walks two minutes to the Paphos UNESCO mosaics and the Tombs of the Kings, and shares the Annabelle's gardens via a connecting path. For honeymooners who want design-forward Paphos at a price below Anassa — and with a stronger adults-only programming than the Annabelle — Almyra is the right choice.
content.best_room: Kyma Suite Sea View — the rooftop adults-only suite category with private terrace, sea view, and direct access to the Kyma rooftop pool and Notios restaurant. The Kyma Suite Pool View is the value entry at around €450/night. The Kyma category is non-negotiable for honeymooners; the lower-floor Family rooms (no Kyma access) lose the property's signature feature.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival at Paphos International
itinerary_7_nights.description: Direct to Paphos (PFO), 15-minute transfer to the hotel. Almyra welcome at the lobby, rooftop tour of Kyma, sunset on the Notios terrace. First dinner at Notios (Mediterranean small plates, rooftop, adults-only).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Pafos UNESCO Mosaics
itinerary_7_nights.description: Walk 5 minutes from the hotel to the Pafos Archaeological Park (open from 8am). Two hours exploring the Houses of Dionysos, Theseus, and Aion mosaics. Continue to the Tombs of the Kings 10 minutes north. Lunch back at the Almyra beach pool. Afternoon yoga on the Kyma terrace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Aphrodite's Rock Sunset
itinerary_7_nights.description: Beach morning at Almyra, lunch at Ouzeri, late afternoon drive 25 minutes east to Petra tou Romiou (Aphrodite's Rock) for the sunset swim — the canonical Cyprus honeymoon photograph. Dinner at the Aphrodite Hills resort taverna across the road.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Akamas Peninsula Boat Trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 60 minutes northwest to Latchi for a half-day boat trip to the Blue Lagoon. Swim stops at hidden Akamas coves, lunch on board. Return to Almyra by 6pm for an evening at Notios.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa Day and Pool Rest
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full rest day — late breakfast at Mosaics, 90-minute couples massage in the Almyra Spa, afternoon at the Kyma adults-only rooftop pool. Sunset cocktails on the suite terrace, dinner in-villa.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Troodos Mountains
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 90 minutes east into the Troodos range — Omodos for lunch, Kykkos Monastery, the Byzantine chapels of Pedoulas. Cool mountain air. Return to Almyra for a late dinner at Helios overlooking the harbour.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast at Mosaics, last beach swim, 15-minute transfer back to PFO. Almyra is one of the easiest checkouts in Cyprus.

caveats: Kyma is the honeymoon zone; the main hotel is family-friendly, and the lower-floor non-Kyma rooms include children at the main pool. Book a Kyma category specifically.
The beach in front of the property is small grey-pebble (typical Paphos) — guests use the seawater pool and the beach club for sand. The Akamas at Latchi is the day-trip for proper sand.
Almyra is more design-restrained than the Annabelle's lush garden style — couples wanting tropical-jungle ambience over modernist clean lines should book the sister property Annabelle instead.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Yes, ideal — Almyra has the highest couples-percentage of any Cyprus 5-star (64%) thanks to the Kyma adults-only rooftop zone. Kyma Suite Sea View is the definitive honeymoon room, with a price point notably below Anassa.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: April through October. May, June, September, and the first half of October are ideal. Almyra operates year-round and is a good warm-winter option for European honeymoons in November or March.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Kyma Suite Sea View categories book 5–6 months ahead for the May–October peak. Mention honeymoon at booking — Almyra is consistent with Kyma upgrades when available.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: The hotel is family-friendly resort-wide, but the Kyma rooftop zone is adults-only with its own pool, restaurant (Notios), and yoga terrace. Honeymooners must book a Kyma category.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Kyma Suite Sea View — rooftop adults-only suites with private terrace and direct Kyma pool access. The Kyma Suite Pool View is the value-entry Kyma category.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Paphos International (PFO) is 15 minutes by private transfer (€25–€40 each way). Almyra arranges all transfers. Larnaca (LCA) is 90 minutes east.
